items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I liked him because he was so clean and so quiet, so nice. And we went together for about two years.

ctx.x: And he was my, what you would call, sweetheart. He was my sweetheart long before I met Zutty. Because when I first started playing with my brother's band Jerome was playing saxophone. I had

just finished highschool. He was finishing the next year. He was still going to highschool. And oh boy, I liked him because he was so clean and so quiet, so nice. And we went together for about two years. After he finished school he said he wanted to go to Chicago to study music to get a degree. Because after he went to Chicago he started playing with Doc Cook's band.
